#  marketCount 237, memberCount 3255 at capture ~2026-10-01: raw_captured/sig-tournament.json from github.com/nullif1ed/sigprediction).

# ALL 237 MARKETS. Titles + SIG market/exchange ids from github.com/DanielCWeng/predictions-cup data/mappings/sig_polymarket_2026.csv
# (commit fb4f6c6, 2026-10-04; that participant marks every row VERIFIED). Cross-check: the 13 markets in raw_captured/sig-markets.json
# (sigprediction capture, 2026-10-01) match these ids, exchange ids and titles exactly. VERIFY against your own GET /markets before relying on any id.
#
# TITLE GRAMMAR (all 237 match):  ^Will the (Democratic|Republican|Independent) Party win the (.+)\?$
#   race part:  "U.S. House" | "U.S. Senate"                          -> chamber control
#               "<State full name> Senate" | "<State full name> Governor"
#               "<ST>-<NN> House race"   (two-digit district, e.g. "ME-02 House race", "AZ-01 House race")
# Counts: 92 House-race markets, 71 Governor, 70 Senate, 4 chamber-control; parties D=117 R=117 I=3.
# PAIRING: 117 races = 114 two-market races (D+R) + 3 three-market races (D+R+I: Rhode Island Governor, Montana Senate, Nebraska Senate).
#   Every market is a separate BINARY market with exactly ONE exchange, option "YES", initialPrice 0.5, isMultiOutcome false, isComposite false.
#   Pair by the parsed race key, NEVER by adjacent ids (FL-09: D = 211, R = 322; VA-01: R = 249, D = 342).
#   exchange id = market id + 689 for all 237 rows (asserted by _build_titles.py) but read exchanges[0].id rather than relying on it.
#   Legs of a race are mutually exclusive but not guaranteed exhaustive (a winner from an unlisted party makes every listed leg NO):
#   a YES basket (sum of YES asks < 1) is NOT riskless; a NO basket (sum of YES bids > 1, buy NO on every leg) is.
# CATEGORIES: "Election Outcome" (state races) and "Freeform" (U.S. House control) seen in the 13 captured markets; "?" = not captured.
# settlementDate "2026-11-04T17:00:00.000Z" (= Cup end) on every captured market; settledWith/settledOn null.
# NOT IN THE CUP: Ohio (Senate special and Governor), and e.g. Pennsylvania/Wisconsin/Arizona/Nevada Senate (not up in 2026), NC Governor.
#
# EXTERNAL MAPPINGS (other participants' work, unverified by us):
#   pm_winner_id / pm_label: market in Polymarket's "<Race> Election Winner" event + its groupItemTitle, from github.com/grissou/prediction-market-maker
#     ref_map.json (commit a49587c, 2026-10-01; name matching + hand review). For NH/ME/GA/NE/LA Senate, AZ-01, ME-02 and chamber control these ids
#     AGREE with Daniel's independent mapping. Empty = no party-level winner market found (AK Senate/Governor, CA Governor, CA-22; CA-22 has Daniel EXACT ids).
#   daniel_class / daniel_pm: DanielCWeng's class. EXACT/NEAR = one Polymarket market (id shown); DERIVED = sum of that party's margin-of-victory
#     buckets in one negRisk event (bucket count shown); NO_TRADE = only candidate-specific external markets, fail closed.
#   kalshi_ticker: from github.com/christiano7777777/sig-arb-bot kalshi_map.json (commit a209d57, 2026-10-05). "*" = chamber tickers taken from
#     sigprediction lib/core/races.ts and sig-arb-bot config.py (CONTROLS-2026-D/R, CONTROLH-2026-D/R). Empty = not mapped (independent legs,
#     MT/NE Senate, RI/KS/NH/AK Governor). Kalshi naming: SENATE<ST>-26, SENATEFLS-26 (FL special), KXSENATELA-26NOV (LA), GOVPARTY<ST>-26,
#     HOUSE<ST><N>-26 (legacy) or KXHOUSERACE-<ST><NN>-26 (newer); market ticker = event ticker + "-D" / "-R".
#
